package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_io_operations_temporary_file_for_stream_transform: Layer: I/O operations. Flag temporary files used only to bridge streaming transformations.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario553Positive(r io.Reader) ([]byte, error) {
	// Writes all input to a temp file, then reads it back for
	// transformation. Uses disk I/O when an in-memory pipe or
	// buffer would suffice for the stream transform.
	tmp, _ := os.CreateTemp("", "stream-*")
	defer os.Remove(tmp.Name())
	defer tmp.Close()

	io.Copy(tmp, r)
	tmp.Seek(0, 0)

	return io.ReadAll(tmp)
}
